config.notes: Two page kinds. Handbook (CourseLoop): course data in __NEXT_DATA__ - title, CRICOS code, IELTS, duration, offerings (location, mode, student type), level, AQF level, guidance. Study pages (flinders.edu.au/study/courses): postgraduate and research pages print an international block (CRICOS code, delivery mode, duration, annual fee, start dates) after the domestic block (SATAC, CSP/FFP fees); the fee pattern skips amounts marked (CSP) or (FFP). Delivery (mode/campus): read after this course's CRICOS code (or just before it on research pages listing several courses) and must start with a delivery word (In person, On campus, Online, ...) - 5 Oct: this stops the handbook text "Delivery mode definitions" being read as a mode. International view: most undergraduate (bachelor, honours, graduate certificate) study pages print only the domestic block; a rendered read with no address change, ?studentType=international and #international were tested on 2 pages (5 Oct) and none showed the international block, so page_view is off. English for all courses comes from the approved central English policy. Handbook pages fall back to json_paths.mode, which lists every offering (domestic too). 5 Oct: entry_requirement (review only, not admitted): undergraduate 'Prerequisites ... Assumed knowledge ...' from the international block, postgraduate/honours 'Entry requirements Applicants must ...' / 'Entry into ...'. No exit-award sentence with full-time years (exit-only awards are printed with units only), no whole-course fee.
